Title: Create a new order with customer details, items, and measurements
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists in the system. An item with ID 1 (e.g., 'Shirt') exists in the system.

Title: Create a new order with multiple items and measurement groups
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists in the system. Items with IDs 1 (e.g., 'Shirt') and 2 (e.g., 'Pant') exist in the system.

Title: Create a new order with minimal required fields (no customer photo or item photos)
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists in the system. An item with ID 1 (e.g., 'Shirt') exists in the system.

Title: Attempt to create an order with a non-existent shop ID
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/orders with the request body specified in testData.

Test Data: {
  "customerName": "John Doe",
  "customerPhone": "1234567890",
  "customerGender": "male",
  "orderGender": "male",
  "customerPhotoUrl": "http://example.com/photo.jpg",
  "shopId": 999999,
  "items": []
}
Expected Result: The request is rejected and the system returns an error response indicating that no shop was found with ID: 999999. The order is not created.

Title: Attempt to create an order containing an item ID that does not exist
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists in the system. No item exists with ID 888888.
Expected Result: The request is rejected and the system returns an error response indicating that no item was found with ID: 888888. The order is not created.

Title: Create an order with an empty items collection
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists in the system.
Steps:
1. Send a POST request to /api/orders with the payload provided in testData.

Test Data: {
  "customerName": "John Doe",
  "customerPhone": "1234567890",
  "customerGender": "male",
  "orderGender": "male",
  "shopId": 1,
  "items": []
}
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK with response body containing the saved order with ID and an empty list for 'orderItems'.

Title: Create an order item with item quantity set to 0
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists and an item with ID 10 exists in the system.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK with response body containing the saved order and an order item record with quantity equal to 0.

Title: Create a measurement entry with value set to zero (0.0)
Preconditions: A shop with ID 1 exists and an item with ID 10 exists in the system.
Expected Result: HTTP 200 OK with response body containing the saved order and measurement with value equal to 0.0.
